resources.string:
A player for playlists you already have.
It ships with no channels, no films and no way to find any. If you do not already have a playlist or an IPTV subscription, there is nothing here to watch yet — and this project will not help you find one.

You add your own sources, and you are responsible for them — including whether watching them is legal where you live.
Nothing you enter leaves this device except to the servers you name yourself. There is no account, no tracking, and no server of ours.
Quiblo is free software under the GPLv3 and comes with no warranty of any kind.
Favourites and what you have half-watched are kept per person. Playlists and settings are shared.
Nothing is kept when the session ends
